payload.audience: 30s, couples who are interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, 150k+ AUD budget
payload.reader: An Australian couple in their 30s with a generous budget who have Greece on the shortlist, searched for what a wedding there costs, and need to understand what actually makes up the total (island, venue, season, guests, paperwork, travel, accommodation, extra events), what a package bundles and what sits outside it, and how paying in euro from Australia works before they ask anyone for a quote.
payload.goal: Speak with a Wedded Advisor about a Greece wedding (single primary CTA to Wedded Concierge, placed after the paying from Australia section); /magazine as the soft secondary in the close.
payload.service_link: /wonderland-concierge (primary, UTM-tagged, anchor 'Wedded Concierge'): ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=greece-wedding-cost&utm_content=primary then ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=greece-wedding-cost&utm_content=closing; /magazine (secondary magnet): ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=greece-wedding-cost&utm_content=secondary. Concierge primary appears before the secondary; each UTM once; no CTA marker comments.
payload.angle: Page-one results lead with a headline figure that a couple planning an island wedding with guests flying from Australia cannot use. We say plainly there is no single figure, then show what the total is made of in Greece specifically: which island and what kind of venue, whether you take exclusive use, season and day of week as our month by month page and its official sources describe them, guest numbers, the civil or church route and its fees as the official sources state them, ferries, flights and transfers framed as questions, guest accommodation, and welcome and farewell events. Then a component checklist of what packages bundle and what is extra (linking our Greece packages guides), and the part no competitor covers for Australians: paying in euro from AUD, deposits and payment timing, contracts in English, written quotes and ACCC guidance. No figures of any kind, by the person's decision.
must_include: Intro with a direct answer: there is no single figure, because the total depends on island, venue type, season, guest numbers and how much guest travel you cover. Then exactly 4 one sentence Key takeaways.

What shapes the cost (H2, non question, no colon, dash or hyphen), as advice not statistics, with H3s for: island and venue type, and exclusive use; season and day of week, described only as /destination-weddings/best-time-to-get-married-in-greece and its official sources (HNMS pack) state them; guest numbers; the legal route (civil or church) and its fees as the official sources state them, with no amounts, reusing the getting-married-in-Greece source pack; getting there and getting around (flights, ferries, transfers, island hopping) written as questions to ask; accommodation for guests; welcome and farewell events.

What packages include and what is extra (H2): a component checklist with no prices (for example ceremony setup, reception venue hire, catering and drinks, coordination on the day, paperwork support, styling, photography, music, transfers, accommodation, welcome and farewell events), each marked as commonly bundled or commonly extra only as phrasing to confirm, never as a claim about any named venue; link /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-packages and /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-packages-all-inclusive (both drafts, so LINK comments unless live), and /destination-weddings/santorini-wedding-packages and /destination-weddings/crete-wedding-packages the same way where they fit.

Paying for a wedding in Greece from Australia (H2): prices in euro and the AUD exchange with no rates; deposits and when payments fall due; contracts in English; written quotes for like for like comparison; ACCC guidance on deposits, contracts and cancellations reused from the photographer cost pack and linked at the claim; Smartraveller Greece lines where useful. The single Wedded Advisor body line sits here or straight after: the Advisor quotes in AUD for Australian couples and has inclusions confirmed in writing before you commit. Primary Concierge CTA follows this section.

How to budget (H2): questions to ask the venue and planner, with no figures (what is included at this guest number, what changes in peak season or on a weekend, what is charged per guest, which payments are in euro and when, what happens if numbers change, what the cancellation terms are in writing).

FAQ (4 to 6 questions, no figures; questions allowed only here), for example: Can you get a single figure for a Greece wedding; Are prices quoted in euro or AUD; Is the legal ceremony fee included in a package; Do guests pay their own travel and accommodation; Is a weekday wedding a different price.

Close with the Wedded Advisor line from brand-facts.md: one Wedded Advisor plans venue, travel, vendors and payments, anywhere in the world, and the fee is agreed in writing before any work begins; link Wedded Concierge (closing UTM) and /magazine.

Internal links: /destinations/europe/greece; /destination-weddings/santorini-wedding; /destination-weddings/mykonos-wedding; /destination-weddings/wedding-in-crete; /destination-weddings/best-time-to-get-married-in-greece (season claims); Greece packages drafts as LINK comments; /destination-weddings/all-inclusive-wedding-cost (no figures quoted from it); /expert-advice/how-much-does-a-wedding-in-italy-cost; /expert-advice/how-to-plan-a-destination-wedding; /destination-weddings/weddings-abroad-where-can-you-legally-get-married; /wonderland-concierge; /magazine. The getting married in Greece legal page only if live (it is not in the link map as live at 2026-11-27, so omit or LINK comment).
avoid: Figures of any kind: amounts, ranges, averages, percentages, exchange rates, From prices, per guest rates, numeric survey results (person's decision; nothing for Nic's sign-off)
Legal fees stated as amounts; describe only that fees apply and who sets them, as the official sources state them
Venue or vendor names, and links to /venue/* or package venue pages
'Best' (outside the fixed URL of the best time page), rankings, statistics, research talk, 'free', 'last dance'
Season claims beyond what the best time page and its official sources state
Same-sex legal position beyond the text of the law; link /destination-weddings/same-sex-marriage-greece only if needed, as a draft LINK comment
Business details: no claims about our fees, commissions, negotiated or supplier rates, discounts, availability or Wedded Privileges
Advisor claims beyond the two body phrases and the close fee line from brand-facts.md
Headings with colons, dashes or hyphens (write 'all inclusive', 'one sentence'), and question headings outside the FAQ
Competitor wording, claims, cost surveys or images (no Easy Weddings or similar)
